findings.issue: OpenCode v2 invocation times use the enclosing message timestamp instead of native tool time or null.
findings.disposition: Fixed: project native tool invocation time; preserve null when absent.

findings.issue: Strict rejection of old capture snapshots prevents their own source recovery and blocks unrelated tickets.
findings.disposition: Fixed: recover unsupported caches through metadata and successful native extraction while preserving opaque bytes and accepted owners on failure.

findings.issue: OpenCode persists child links contradicted by known native parent metadata.
findings.disposition: Fixed: suppress child links contradicted by native parent metadata; retain delegations and unavailable explicit IDs.
